2:253: Imazanen agi, Nesmenyaf kra i wiyaḍ. Garasen, wid iwumi Immeslay Ṛebbi. Issuli kra segsen, tiseddaṛin. Nefka abeggen i Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem, u Nekfa t s ṛṛuḥ iṛqan. Lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, ur ţţemyenɣan wid i ten id iḍefṛen, deffir n tisin ubeggen ɣuṛsen. Maca, mgarraden. Segsen wid iumnen, segsen wid ijehlen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, ur ţţemyenɣan, maca Ṛebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
2:254: A wid iumnen! Seddqet seg wayen ikwen Nɣat, uqbel tisin n wass ideg ur telli ttjara, neɣ tiddukla, neɣ ccafuɛa. Ijehliyen, d nitni ay d imednas.
2:255: Ṛebbi, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa, Amuddir, Imezgi. Ur Iţnuddum, ur Iggan. IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Anwa akka ara icufɛan ɣuṛeS, siwa ma s tsriḥ iS? Issen i illan zdat sen, i illan deffir sen. Ur ḥemṣen kra, si tmusni S, siwa ayen i S ihwan. Lewsaɛ usgeld iS, d tamurt akked igenwan. Ur T issaɛtab uḥareb fellasen. Neţţa, d Aɛlayan, d Ameqwṛaḥan.
2:256: Ddin mačči s yiɣil. Niɣ teţwafṛez lewqama si lɣwelṭa. Win iugin iṛebbiten n tkerkas u iumen s Ṛebbi, ihi, iṭṭef afus ioehden, ur nceqqeq. Ṛebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
2:257: Ṛebbi d Bab n wid iumnen. Issuffeɣ iten id si tillas ar tafat. Imawlan n wid ijehlen, d iṛebbiten n tkerkas. Ssuffɣen ten id si tafat ar tillas. Widak, d at tmes, nitni, degs ad wekkṛen.
2:258: Day ur twalaḍ ara win inumren Ibṛahim ɣef Mass is, acku Ifka yas Ṛebbi tagelda? Mi inna Ibṛahim: "Mass iw d win Issidiren, Ineqqen", inna d: "nek ssidireɣ, neqqeɣ". Inna Ibṛahim: "ihi, Ṛebbi Issenqaṛ ed iṭij seg ugmuḍ; kečč, ssenqeṛ it id seg utaram"! Inneḥcam win ijehlen. Ṛebbi ur Inehhu yara agdud imednas.
2:259: Neɣ am win iɛaddan di temdint tilemt, thudd wakali. Inna: «amek ara d Issider Ṛebbi tagi, deffir tmeţţant is?» Inɣa t Ṛebbi twinas iseggwasen, sinna, Issenker it, Inna: «acḥal teqqimeḍ?» Inna d: «qqimeɣ ibwass, neɣ ur ibbwiḍ wass». Inna: «xaṭi, teqqimeḍ twinas iseggwasen. Muqel lqut ik akked tissit ik, ur xṣiṛen. Muqel aɣyul ik. A k Nerr d assekni i medden. Muqel iɣsan amek ara ten Nessemlil, sinna, ad asen Nessels aksum». Mi iţţutebbet, inna: «ẓṛiɣ Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci».
2:260: U mi inna Ibṛahim: «a Mass iw! Ssenɛat iyi amek tessidireḍ lmeggtin». Inna: «day ur tumineḍ ara?» Inna: «xaṭi, maca iwakken ad ithedden wul iw». Inna: «ihi, ṭṭef kuẓ igḍaḍ, awi ten id ɣuṛek, sinna, err, di yal iɣil, amur segsen. Sinna, siwel asen, a d asen dumatu. Cfu ar Ṛebbi d Uohid, d Uṣwib».
2:261: Wid iţseddiqen ayla nnsen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, cuban aɛqqa id igren sa tyedrin. Di yal taydreţ, twinas iɛqqayen. Ṛebbi Issugut i win i S Ihwan. Ṛebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
2:262: Wid iţseddiqen ayla nnsen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, ur seddan, i wayen ssedqen, tiyta neɣ rregmat, ad awin arraz nnsen sɣuṛ Mass nnsen; ur ţţagwaden, ur ɣweblen.
2:263: Awal imaɛnen akked ssmaḥ, ifen aseddeq i ḍefṛent rregmat. Ṛebbi d Asɛay, Iḥellem.
2:264: A wid iumnen! Ur ssemsayet ssadaqa nnwen, s tiyta akked rregmat. Am win iseddqen ayla s, iwakken a t walin medden, ur iumin s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru. Icuba taẓṛut i iɣumm wakal. Iwwet fellas uzayeḍ, iooa ţ d asuki. Ur sfaydin acemma seg wayen bbwin. Ṛebbi ur Inehhu ara agdud ijehliyen.
2:265: Wid iţseddiqen ayla nnsen, ssaramen ad Iṛaḍi Ṛebbi, u tebbten iman nnsen, cuban leonan di tiɣilt. Iwwet fellas ugeffur, ifka d sin imuren n lɣella s. Ma ur iwwit fellas ugeffur, d nnda. Ṛebbi Iţwali ayen txeddmem.
2:266: Yiwen degwen, ma tusa t id tewser, u ɣuṛes tarwa tuṛhift, day ad issirem ad isɛu leonan n tezdayin akked tfeṛṛant, isaffen ţţazzalen ddaw as, degs, i neţţa, yal ţţemṛa? Tḥuza t tnifift degs times, iṛɣa. Akka i wen Iţbeggin Ṛebbi issekniyen, amar a ţmeyyzem.
2:267: A wid iumnen! Seddqet seg wayen imaɛnen i teṭfem, seg wayen i wen d Nessuffeɣ si tmurt. Ur fernet ucmit, segs, ayen ur teţţadamem siwa ma s tuqna n wallen, a t tseddqem. Cfut ar Ṛebbi d Asɛay, d Amaɛzuz.
2:268: Cciṭan iɛahed awen tiggulelt, iumeṛ awen lɛaṛ. Ṛebbi Iɛahed awen ssmaḥ sɣuṛeS akked lfeḍl. Ṛebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
2:269: Iţţak ṣṣwab i win i S Ihwan. Win iwumi iţţunefk ṣṣwab, niɣ iţţunefk as aṭas n lxiṛ. Siwa uɛqilen i ismektayen.
2:270: Ayen tefkam useddeq, neɣ teqqnem n tuqqna, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iẓṛa t. Ur llin imɛiwnen i imednas.
2:271: Ma tefkam ssadaqat ɛinani, ilha. Yif it ma s tuffra, u ma tefkam tent i imeɣban. Ad ţwakksent kra si tucmitin nnwen. Ṛebbi Iţţuxebbeṛ ɣef wayen txeddmem.
2:272: Ur fellak a ten tenhuḍ. Maca Ṛebbi Inehhu win i S Ihwan. Ayen tefkam n lxiṛ, i iman nnwen. Ur tefkim siwa ɣef udem n Ṛebbi. Ayen tefkam n lxiṛ, a kwen id iuɣal, u kunwi ur kwen dennisen.
2:273: I imeɣban ifelsen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, ur nezmir ad inigen di tmurt; wur nessin, inwa ten d imeṛkantiyen, seg wakken ḥekmen. A ten tɛaqleḍ ar tiddi nnsen: ur ssuturen imdanen s nnbec. Ayen tefkam n lxiṛ, s tideţ, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa t.
2:274: Wid ifkan ayla nnsen deg iḍ, deg wass, s tuffra u ɛinani, ad awin arraz nnsen ar Mass nnsen; ur ţţagwaden, ur ɣweblen.
2:275: Wid iteţţen rrba, ur d ţnekkaren siwa am ara d kren win issexbibeḍ Cciṭan, mi t innul. Ayagi, acku nnan: «ttjara am rrba kan». Ṛebbi Iḥell ttjara, Igdel rrba. Win n tusa lewṣaya sɣuṛ Mass is, dɣa ixḍa, ines ayen iɛaddan. Lameṛ is ar Ṛebbi. Wid iuɣalen, widak d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkṛen.
2:276: Ad Imḥu Ṛebbi rrba, ad Isbuṛket ssadaqa. Ṛebbi ur Iḥemmel ara yal ajehli amednub.
2:277: Ih, wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, u ţẓallan, u ţzekkin, ad awin arraz nnsen ar Mass nnsen; ur ţţagwaden, ur ɣweblen.
2:278: A wid iumnen! Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Eooet ayen d igwran si rrba, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
2:279: Ma ur tewqimem ara, ḥṣut ara kwen Innaɣ Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma tnedmem, nnwen ṛaselmal. Ur denniset, ur ţwadenset.
2:280: I win illan di lhejna, aṛout liser. Ma tseddqem, yif it i kunwi, lemmer teẓṛim.
2:281: Ḥezzbet i wass n tuɣalin nnwen ar Ṛebbi. Imiren, yal yiwen ad as iţţunefk wayen ikseb; nitni ur ţwadensen.
2:282: A wid iumnen! Ma tesɛam ṭlaba ar lajel iţwassnen, arut eţ. A ţ iaru umaru segwen, s ṣṣfawa. Ur iţţagwi umaru a ţ iaru, akken i s Isselmed Ṛebbi. Ad iaru ayen ar as yini umeṭṭalbu. Ad iḥezzeb i Ṛebbi, Mass is. Ur issenqas acemma segs. Ma illa umeṭṭalbu d abuhal, neɣ d uṛhif, neɣ ur izmir ad yini neţţa, ihi, ad yini umeddakwel is s ṣṣfawa. Sbeddet sin inagan seg irgazen nnwen. Ma ur llin ara sin irgazen, argaz akked snat n tlawin, seg wid tṛuḍam ad cehhden. Ma teɣleḍ yiwet segsent, tayeḍ a d temmekti. Ur ţţagwin inagan, ma ţwanecden. Ur stehzayet a ţ tarum, meẓẓiyet neɣ meqqwṛet, ar lajel is. Ayagi iwzen kteṛ ar Ṛebbi, iwata kteṛ i ccada, iwulem kteṛ ad awen ikkes ccekk. Kkes ed ssuq i tefram imiren garawen; ulac uɣilif fellawen, ma ur t turim ara. Awit inagan deg uzenzi nnwen. Ur iţţili ujuṛu ɣef umaru neɣ ɣef unagi. Ma tjuṛem, ihi, dir ikwen. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Isselmad ikwen. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa yal cci.
2:283: Ma d iminigen ay tellam, ur tufim amaru, a ţţeţţunefk ṛṛhina. Ma ifka yiwen segwen lamana i wayeḍ, win iwumi teţţunefk, a ţ irr i win i s ifkan lamana s. Ad iḥezzeb i Ṛebbi, Mass is. Ur ţţeffret ccada. Win iţ iffren, ihi, neţţa, idneb wul is. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ay txeddmem.
2:284: N Ṛebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ama tesseknem i illan deg iman nnwen, neɣ teɣbam t, a kwen Iḥaseb Ṛebbi fellas. Ad Isemmeḥ i win i S Ihwan, ad Iɛaqeb win i S Ihwan. Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
2:285: Iumen Umazan s wayen id iusan, ɣuṛes, sɣuṛ Mass is. Lmumnin, akw, umnen s Ṛebbi akked lmalayek iS, Tizmamin iS, imazanen iS. Ur nesemgirrid yiwen ger imazanen iS. Nnan: «nesla, nunez. Ssmaḥ iK a Mass nneɣ! ɣuṛeK tuɣalin.
2:286: Ur Iţkellif Ṛebbi yiman, siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Ines wayen ikseb, mgal is wayen iddem. A Mass nneɣ! Ur aɣ Pqassa ma neţţu, neɣ necceḍ. A Mass nneɣ! Ur aɣ Sbibbi taɛkkwemt akken iţ Tesbabbeḍ i wid i ɣ d izwaren. A Mass nneɣ! Ur aɣ Sbibbi ayen iwumi ur nezmir. Semmeḥ aneɣ, Suref aɣ, Ḥun fellaneɣ. Kečč d Bab nneɣ, Srebḥ aɣ ɣef ugdud ijehliyen.
3:2: Ṛebbi, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa, Amuddir, Imezgi.
3:3: Issers ak d Tazmamt s tideţ, d atebbet n wayen iţ id izwaren. Issers ed Tuṛa akked Linoil,
3:4: uqbel, d nnhaya i medden. Issers ed Leqwṛan. Ih, wid inekṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi, fellasen aɛaqeb uqṣiḥ. Ṛebbi d Uzmir, Iţţara d ţţaṛ.
3:5: Ih, Ṛebbi ur aS iffir wacemma di tmurt, neɣ deg igenni.
3:6: D Neţţa i wen Iţţaken udem, di tɛabbaḍ, akken i S ihwa. Ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
3:7: Neţţa i k ed Issersen Tazmamt, degs issekniyen uḍhiṛen, nitni d tayimmaţ n Tezmamt. Wiyaḍ d licwaṛ. Dɣa, wid iwumi mmalen wulawen, teddun akked wayen illan d licwaṛ, ssaramen ahewwel, ssaramen asefhem is. I Issnen asefhem is, siwa Ṛebbi. Qqaṛen imawlan n tmusni: "numen yis. Sɣuṛ Mass nneɣ akw". Id ismektayen, siwa uɛqilen.
3:8: A Mass nneɣ! Ur Smili ulawen nneɣ, mbaɛd ma Tenhiḍ aɣ. Efk aɣ d, sɣuṛeK, aḥunu. Ih, Kečč, ard Amɣit.
3:9: A Mass nneɣ! Kečč, s tideţ, ara Ijemmlen medden, ass iɣef ur illi ccekk. S tideţ, Ṛebbi ur Izeggel lemɛahda.
3:10: Ih, wid ijehlen, ur sen d iţţawi acemma, ar Ṛebbi, wayla nnsen, neɣ tarwa nnsen. Widak, d nitni ay d isufa n tmes.
3:11: D tin n ugdud n Ferɛun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Skaddben issekniyen nneɣ. Iwwet iten Ṛebbi, ilmend ibekkaḍen nnsen. Ṛebbi Iwɛaṛ i uɛaqeb.
3:12: Ini i wid ijehlen: "a ţţeţwaɣelbem, a ţţeţwafesrem di Loahennama". A yir usu!
3:13: Niɣ d assekni, i kunwi, mi mlalent snat trebbuyaɛ. Yiwet teţnaɣ deg ubrid n Ṛebbi; tayeḍ d tajehlit, twala d snat, s yiẓṛi s. Ṛebbi Iţţak afus, s tallalt iS, i win i S ihwan. Deg wayagi, s tideţ, aselmed i wid iţwalin.
3:14: D tucbiḥt ay d tedheṛ i yimdanen leḥmala n ccehwiyyat: tilawin, tarwa, iɛammuṛen ibararen n ddheb akked lfeṭṭa, iɛawdiwen n ccetla, lmal, akal. Ayagi, d zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit. Ṛebbi, ɣuṛeS amkan lɛali, n tuɣalin.
3:15: Ini: "ad awen mleɣ i yifen aya? I wid iţḥezziben, ar Mass nnsen, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen, tilawin iṣfan, akked llza sɣuṛ Ṛebbi". Ṛebbi Iţwali imdanen;
3:16: wid iqqaṛen: "a Mass nneɣ! Nekwni, s tideţ, numen. Ihi, Semmeḥ aɣ ibekkaḍen nneɣ, Sellek aɣ seg uɛaqeb n tmes".
3:17: Iṣebṛiyen, imawlan n tideţ, imḍuɛen, wid iţseddiqen, wid isteɣfiṛen di tafrara.
3:18: Icuhhed Ṛebbi ar ur illi ṛebbi, siwa Neţţa. Akken lmalayek, akked imawlan n tmusni. Ibedd i lmizan. Ur illi ṛebbi, siwa Neţţa, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
3:19: Ih, ddin ar Ṛebbi d annuz. Ur mgarraden wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, armi deffir n tisin n tussna ɣuṛsen, wa iqheṛ wa. Wid inekṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi, ihi, Ṛebbi Iţɣawal deg uqeṭṭi.
3:20: Ma nuqmen k, ini: "unzeɣ aS i Ṛebbi. Akken, wid iddan yidi. Ini i wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, akked at war tussna: "ma tunzem"? Ma unzen, ihi, ţwanhan. Ma wexxṛen, ay fellak siwa anabi. Ṛebbi Iţwali imdanen.
3:21: Ih, wid inekṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi, u ţnaɣen lambiyya, war ssebba, u ţnaɣen wid seg yimdanen iţţamṛen lmizan, becceṛ iten s uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
3:22: Widak, d wid iwumi mḥan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxert. Ur sɛin isellaken.
3:23: Day ur twalaḍ ara wid iwumi iţţunefk kra si Tezmamt, la ssuturen, i Tezmamt n Ṛebbi, aḥuddu garasen? Sinna, ad iwexxeṛ urbaɛ segsen, u nitni ţnamaren.
3:24: Ayagi, acku nnan: "ur aɣ teţţeţ tmes, siwa kra n wussan". Iɣuṛṛ iten, di ddin nnsen, wayen id snulfuyen.
3:25: Amek ihi, ma Njemmel iten, ass ideg, ur degs ccekk, yal yiwen ad iɣellet ayen ikseb, nitni ur ţţudensen.
3:26: Ini: "a Ṛebbi, Agellid n tgelda, Teţţakeḍ tagelda i win i K ihwan, Teţţekseḍ tagelda i win i K ihwan, Teţɛuzzuḍ win i K ihwan, Tesdulluḍ win i K ihwan. Lxiṛ deg ufus i K. Ih, Kečč, Tzemreḍ i yal cci.
3:27: Tessekcameḍ iḍ deg wass. Tessekcameḍ ass deg iḍ. Tessuffuɣeḍ amuddir si lmegget. Tessuffuɣeḍ lmegget seg umuddir. Teţɣitiḍ win i K ihwan, war aktili".
3:28: Lmumnin ur ţţaran ijehliyen d iḥbiben nnsen, war lmumnin. Win ixedmen aya, ur illi, s wacemma, ar Ṛebbi. Kkes ed aḥezzeb i tḥezzbem iman nnwen segsen. Iɛaggen awen Ṛebbi s yiman iS. Tuɣalin ar Ṛebbi.
3:29: Ini: "ama teffrem i illan deg idmaren nnwen, neɣ tessnaɛtem t, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa t". Iẓṛa i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
3:30: Ass ideg yal iman ad iaf irs ed, wayen ixdem n lxiṛ, akked wayen ixdem n cceṛṛ, ad issirem a ţţili, garas yides, tallit ɣezzifen! Iɛaggen awen Ṛebbi, af yiman iS. Ṛebbi d Umɛin ar imdanen.
3:31: Ini: "ma tḥemmlem Ṛebbi, ddut yidi. A kwen Iɛuzz Ṛebbi, ad awen Isemmeḥ ibekkaḍen nnwen. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu".
3:32: Ini: "ssemḥesset i Ṛebbi akked Umazan". Ma wexxṛen, ihi Ṛebbi ur Iḥemmel ara ijehliyen.
3:33: Ih, Ṛebbi Ismenyaf, i imaḍalen, Adem, Nuḥ, tawacult n Ibṛahim, tawacult n Ɛimṛan.
3:34: Wa iurew wa. Ṛebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
3:35: Mi tenna tmeṭṭut n Ɛimṛan: "a Mass iw! Wekkleɣ aK ayen illan di tɛabbuṭ iw, d lewkala, Eqbel sɣuṛi. Kečč, ih, d win Isellen, d Amusnaw".
3:36: Mi ţ id turew, tenna: "a Mass iw! Urweɣ ţ id d nnta". - Ṛebbi Iẓṛa, sennig akw, d acu d turew. Ddkeṛ, mačči am nnta. - "Nek semmaɣ as Meryem, rriɣ ţ seddaw tecḍaṭ iK, neţţat akked tarwa s, mgal Cciṭan imenfi".
3:37: Iṛḥeb yis Mass is, asteṛḥeb ilhan; Isgem iţ, tigmi ilhan; Ikwellef iţ i Zakariyya. Yal tikelt ara iṛuḥ ɣuṛes Zakariyya ar lmiḥreb, a n iaf tesɛa ṛṛeẓq. Inna: "a Meryem! Ansi i m d ikka waya"? Tenna: "sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iṛeẓẓeq win i S ihwan, war aktili".
3:38: Dɣa Zakariyya inuj ɣuṛ Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d, sɣuṛeK, tarwa ifazen. Kečč, s tideţ, Tselleḍ i unuju".
3:39: Mi ibedd, iţẓalla di lmeḥreb, ssawlent as d lmalayek: "Ibecceṛ ik Ṛebbi s Yaḥia, d atebbet n wawal n Ṛebbi, d ssid, d azedgan, d nnbi, seg iɛaṛḍiyen".
3:40: Inna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sɛuɣ aqcic? Niɣ wessreɣ, tameṭṭut iw d tiɛiqeṛt". Inna: "akka, Ṛebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan".
3:41: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d assekni". Inna: "assekni ik, ur teţmeslayeḍ i medden kraḍ wussan. Asɣal kan. Mmekti d aṭas Mass ik, sbuccaɛ iT tameddit, tafrara".
3:42: Mi s nnant lmalayek: "a Meryem! Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Ifren ikem, Izzazdeg ikem, Ismenyaf ikem i tlawin imaḍalen.
3:43: A Meryem! Anez i Mass im, knu yaS, ṭṭinez akked wid iṭṭinizen".
3:44: Ayagi si tmucuha i iffren, Nweḥḥa yak t. Ur telliḍ yidsen, mi jebden taseqqaṛt, anwa segsen ara itkelfen ɣef Meryem. Ur telliḍ yidsen mi mqellaɛen.
3:45: Mi s nnant lmalayek: "a Meryem! Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Ibecceṛ ikem s wawal sɣuṛeS, ism is: lmasiḥ Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem; mucaɛ di ddunit akked laxert; seg iqṛiben.
3:46: A d iţmeslay i medden, si dduḥ, am unqaqṛi, ad yili seg iɛaṛḍiyen".
3:47: Tenna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sɛuɣ aqcic, ur iyi innul urgaz"? Inna: "akka. Ṛebbi Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Ma Iseyya lameṛ, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili".
3:48: Ad as Isselmed Tazmamt, ṣṣwab, Tuṛa, Linoil.
3:49: D amazan ar At Isṛail: "niɣ nek usiɣ d, ɣuṛwen, s issekniyen sɣuṛ Mass nnwen. Nek ad awen d xelqeɣ, s talaxt, ayen icban afṛux, ad ṣuḍeɣ degs, ad iuɣal d afṛux, ma Ibɣa Ṛebbi. Ad sseḥluɣ aderɣal, amuḍin n lbeṛṣ, a d ssidreɣ lmeggtin, ma Ibɣa Ṛebbi. Ad awen iniɣ d acu teţţeţţem, akked wayen txezznem deg ixxamen nnwen. Deg waya, s tideţ, d assekni i kunwi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
3:50: A d tebbteɣ iyi d izwaren di Tuṛa, ad awen ḥelleɣ kra n wayen illan iţwagdel awen. Usiɣ d, ɣuṛwen, s ussekni, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen. Ḥezbet i Ṛebbi, aɣet iyi awal.
3:51: Ṛebbi, s tideţ, d Mass iw, u d Mass nnwen. Ihi, ɛabdet eP, d wagi ay d abrid uwqim".
3:52: Mi israḥ Ɛisa tijehli sɣuṛsen, inna: "anwi ay d imɛiwnen iw ar Ṛebbi"? Nnan as d lexwan: "nekwni d imɛiwnen n Ṛebbi. Numen s Ṛebbi, eched ar nekwni d imḍuɛen.
3:53: A Mass nneɣ! Numen s wayen id Tesserseḍ, nedda d umazan, Aru yaɣ seg inagan".
3:54: Undin. Iundi Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Yif akw imendayen.
3:55: Mi s Inna Ṛebbi: "a Ɛisa! Nek ad Ddmeɣ ṛṛuḥ ik, a k id Ssaliɣ ɣuṛI, a k id Ssiferreɣ seg wid ijehlen, ad Rreɣ, wid iddan yidek, sennig wid ijehlen, ar ass n tnekra". Sinna, tuɣalin nnwen ɣuṛI, ad Ḥuddeɣ, garawen, ɣef wayen iɣef teţţemgarradem.
3:56: Ma d wid ijehlen, a ten Ɛaqbeɣ di ddunit, di laxert, aɛaqeb aqeṣḥan. Ur asen ţţilin isellaken.
3:57: Wanag wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Ifk arrazen nnsen. Ṛebbi ur Iḥemmel ara imednas.
3:58: Ayagi i ak Nemmal seg issekniyen, akked usmekti uṣwib.
3:59: Ih, amedya n Ɛisa, ar Ṛebbi, am umedya n Adem. Ixelq it seg wakal, sinna, Inna yas: "ili"! Illa.
3:60: Tideţ, sɣuṛ Mass ik. Ur ţţili seg wid iţcukkun.
3:61: I win i k inumren fellas, deffir wayen i k id iusan n tussna, ini: "yyaw a nenced tarwa nneɣ, tarwa nnwen, tilawin nneɣ, tilawin nnwen, iman nneɣ, iman nnwen. Sinna, a nemmesgill, a ndɛu ad Ixzu Ṛebbi ikeddaben.
3:62: Ih, tagi d tamacahuţ n tideţ, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi, Neţţa, war ccekk, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
3:64: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Yyaw ar wawal azduklan garaneɣ yidwen. A naɛbed siwa Ṛebbi, ur aS neţcarak acemma; ur ţţaran, kra segneɣ kra, d iṛebbiten, war Ṛebbi". Ma wexxṛen, init: "cehhdet ar nekwni d imḍuɛen".
3:65: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi temnamarem ɣef Ibṛahim? Ur n risent Tuṛa akked Linoil, armi deffir es, day ur tmeyyzem ara?
3:66: Kunwi, atan temnamarem ɣef wayen tessnem. Ihi, acimi temnamarem ɣef wayen ur tessinem? Ṛebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
3:67: Ur illi Ibṛahim d uday neɣ d amasiḥi, maca illa d amḍuɛ imalen ar tideţ. Ur illi seg imcurak.
3:68: Ih, imdanen iqeṛben nezzeh ar Ibṛahim, war ccekk, d wid i t iḍefṛen, akked Nnbi agi, akked wid iumnen. Ṛebbi d Bab n lmumnin.
3:69: Arbaɛ, seg At Tezmamt, ibɣa a kwen itlef. Ara telfen siwa iman nnsen, ur ẓṛin.
3:70: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi tugim issekniyen n Ṛebbi, u kunwi teţwalim?
3:71: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi teslusum, i tideţ, ayen idensen, u teţţeffrem tideţ, kunwi teḥṣam?
3:72: Arbaɛ, seg At Tezmamt, inna: "amnet mi iuli wass, s wayen id irsen ar wid iumnen, nekṛet tameddit". Amendeṛ ma a d uɣalen.
3:73: Pţamnet kan win iḍefṛen ddin nnwen. Ini: "ih, nnhaya d nnhaya n Ṛebbi. A ţţeţţunefk i yiwen am wayen i wen iţţunefken". Neɣ a kwen namren af Mass nnwen. Ini: "lfeḍl, s tideţ, deg ufus n Ṛebbi, Iţţak it i win i S ihwan". Ṛebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
3:74: Iɛateq aḥunu S i win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl ameqwṛaḥan.
3:75: Seg wAt Tezmamt, illa win, xas teooiḍ as adrim aṭas, ad ak t id irr. Illa wayeḍ segsen, ma teooiḍ as adinar, ur ak t id iţţara, alamma tezgiḍ ɣuṛes. Akka, acku nitni nnan: "ur aɣ d ţţawḍen at war tussna". U ggaren d tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, u nitni ẓṛan.
3:76: Xaṭi! Win iṭṭfen di lemɛahda s, u iḥezzeb…ihi, Ṛebbi Iḥemmel wid iţḥezziben.
3:77: Ih, wid iţţaɣen s lemɛahda n Ṛebbi akked tgallit nnsen, ayen ṛxisen, widak, ur ţţawin amur di laxert, ur asen Iţmeslay Ṛebbi, ur ten id Iţmuqul, ass n tnekra, ur ten Izzizdig. Fellasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
3:78: Ih, arbaɛ segsen ssexsaṛen Tazmamt s yilsawen nnsen, iwakken a ţɣilem n Tezmamt, ayen ur nelli n Tezmamt. Qqaṛen: "aya sɣuṛ Ṛebbi", u neţţa ur illi sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. U qqaren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, u nitni ẓṛan.
3:79: Ur iţţunefk ara i umdan iwumi Ifka Ṛebbi Tazmamt, ṣṣwab, u Irra t d nnbi, ad iuɣal ad yini i medden: "ilit d imdanen iw, war Ṛebbi". Maca: "ilit d iselmaden, imi tesselmadem Tazmamt, u tlemdem".
3:80: Ur awen Iumeṛ ara a ţţerrem lmalayek akked lambiyya, d imawlan. Day awen Iameṛ tijehli, mbaɛd ma tellam d imḍuɛen?
3:81: Mi Iṭṭef Ṛebbi laɛqed n lambiyya: "s tideţ, Fkiɣ awen si Tezmamt akw si ṣṣwab, sinna, iusa kwen id umazan, i itebbten ayen illan ɣuṛwen. Amnet yis, ɛiwnet eţ". Inna: "tɛazmem u tqeblem, f waya, laɛqed iW"? Nnan as: "naɛzem". Inna: "ihi, cehhdet, Nek, yidwen, seg inagan".
3:82: Wid iwexxṛen, deffir waya, nitni d iballaɣen.
3:83: Day bɣan ddin ur nelli n Ṛebbi? U Neţţa, unzen aS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan, bɣan neɣ ugin. ɣuṛeS, tuɣalin nnsen.
3:84: Ini: "numen s Ṛebbi, akked wayen id irsen ɣuṛneɣ, akked wayen id irsen ar Ibṛahim, Ismaɛil, Isḥaq, Iaɛqub, laɛṛac, ayen iţţunefken i Musa, Ɛisa, akked lambiyya, sɣuṛ Mass nnsen. Ur nesmenyaf yiwen degsen. Nekwni nunez aS".
3:85: Win ibɣan ddin, war annuz, ur iţwaqbal sɣuṛes. U neţţa, di laxert, seg imexsuṛen.
3:86: Amek ara Inhu Ṛebbi agdud inekṛen deffir liman is, u cehhden ar Amazan d tideţ, u iusa ten id ubeggen? Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
3:87: Widak, aqeṭṭi nnsen d ddell sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, d lmalayek, akked imdanen meṛṛa.
3:88: Degs ad wekkṛen; ur iţţifsus fellasen uɛaqeb, ur stiseren.
3:89: Kkes ed wid iuɣalen nedmen, deffir waya, u xedmen ayen ilhan. Ih, Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
3:90: Ih, wid ijehlen, deffir liman nnsen, sinna, rnan di tijehli, ur teţwaqbal nndama nnsen. Widak d imɣeṛṛqen.
3:91: Ih, wid ijehlen, u mmuten d ijehliyen, ur iţwaqbal sɣuṛ yiwen degsen, azal n tmurt n ddheb, a t id ifdu. I widak, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan, ur sɛin amɛiwen.
